**Chinese name:** 苏州纳芯微电子股份有限公司 (Nàxīnwēi)

::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
China's most credible challenger to ADI/TI in automotive/energy infrastructure analog, where certification — not lithography — is the moat. Revenue is exploding (+71.8% FY2025 to ¥33.68亿; +66.7% H1 2026 to ¥25.40亿 with first profit turnaround), but core operations remain barely breakeven — the 'buy share with R&D' stage of the climb.
:::

## What does this firm design?

Sensor signal conditioning, isolation/interface, gate drivers and power-path protection for EVs, PV/storage, and industrial systems.

## Key Facts

| | |
|---|---|
| **Category** | Fabless |
| **Founded** | 2013 |
| **Location** | Suzhou, Jiangsu |
| **Product Focus** | Automotive and industrial analog: sensor signal-chain ASICs, magnetic/pressure sensors, digital isolators, gate drivers, LED/motor drivers |
| **Node Sophistication** | Specialty analog nodes undisclosed; flagship metrics: <1µV-referred sensor ASICs, AEC-Q100/Q103 parts, ASIL-D safety chain, 4,200+ SKUs |
